snippet.title: A tale of Love, Hope and Struggle
snippet.description:
"..destiny won't stay idle as we fight it.."
In their hunger for immortality humanity fought "Death the Aeon" but the battle was lost.. their hope was shattered.. and a curse was cast upon them..
Now with only seven days left, nine heroes will start their journey to save the world from Death's grasp.

Available on
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085800/Fate_of_Fire_Kyvedy_Guardiah/

Music "Labyrinth" by Tim Beek https://timbeek.com/
